Instead of assurances of God's presence with the pious, and a complaint of the wicked, <reference osisRef="Ps.14.5">Psa 14:5</reference>, <reference osisRef="Ps.14.6">6</reference> portrays the ruin of the latter, whose "bones" even "are scattered" (compare <reference osisRef="Ps.141.7">Psa 141:7</reference>), and who are put to shame as contemptuously rejected of God. <chapter eID="Ps.53"/>
